definitions.explanation: A place designed for relaxation and recreation, typically offering accommodation and leisure facilities. Used for beach resorts, mountain retreats, hot spring resorts, and other vacation destinations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リゾート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a resort on a southern island.

examples.japanese: リゾートホテル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the whole day at the resort hotel pool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧リゾート{地|ち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{国内外|こくないがい}→国内外：17208_kokunaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Okinawa attracts many tourists from both within and outside Japan as a resort destination.

notes:
USAGE: リゾート is a loanword from English "resort." It is widely used in travel and tourism contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リゾート{地|ち} (resort area, resort destination)
- リゾートホテル (resort hotel)
- ⟦ビーチ→ビーチ：10163_biichi⟧リゾート (beach resort)
- ⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧リゾート (ski resort)
- リゾート⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ (resort mood, vacation feeling)
- リゾート⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (resort development)

NOTE: In Japanese, ⟦{保養地|ほようち}→保養地：20922_hoyouchi⟧ (health resort) and ⟦{行楽地|こうらくち}→行楽地：16447_kourakuchi⟧ (recreation spot) are native alternatives, but リゾート is more common in modern usage for commercial vacation destinations.
